messages.subject: Whitmore — advice on merits and settlement strategy (PRIVILEGED)
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Lorna,

Our merits note is attached and is legally privileged — please keep circulation tight. In short: we assess prospects of defending the automatic unfair dismissal claim at no better than 40–45%, and because the whistleblowing award is uncapped the exposure is material. We recommend an early without-prejudice approach and suggest authority to settle up to £185,000 inclusive plus a fees contribution.

Happy to talk it through on a call.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
